sources.snippet: The same representations support tracking song change across seasons or juvenile development, dialect mapping through shifts in specific song units, and detection of rare species outside a supervised detector's label set. Because the encoder stays frozen and probes are cheap, adoption needs no training infrastructure.

sources.snippet: Self-supervised bioacoustic encoders have been used for species classication but so far have not addressed syllable-level structure in birdsong. We introduce SongMAE, a compact MAE-ViT (Masked Autoencoder Vision Transformer) that operates on mel spectrograms with 2 ms temporal resolution.
